scope: Synthetic macOS ARM64 using unmerged Amu PR 1794 candidate compiler and packager; no Linux fleet integration, live keys, power-loss qualification, deployment or production trust.
knownLimitations: KFR1 and compiler/packager bootstrap are not merged or released.
Native capability and allocation failures can still terminate execution; other write paths may trap on I/O errors.
Read EIO is qualified separately in Linux ARM64 runtime, not injected in this macOS fleet test.
